### Request
Root: `{"runs":[RUN,...]}`. Each run has exactly fields: banks M (1..16), load_balancers L (1..8), fifo_bytes, pifo_bytes, refill_batch (1..32), sample_period (1..100000), borders strictly increasing integer [0,b1,...,U] with 1..64 ranges (so 2..65 borders), policy object, events array.

Ranges: R = len(borders)-1. Range r is [b[r], b[r+1]).

Classify using min(rank, U-1) — the range index r such that borders[r] <= min(rank,U-1) < borders[r+1].

Initially queues empty, t=0, p=0, l=0, a=0, H[r]=0. Counters C shape [L][M][R], C[l][q][r] = 1 when q < (r mod M) else 0.

All arithmetic exact integer. Enqueue's tie ordinal = zero-based index in complete event array (i.e., command index in events array). Output indices and ordinals never rewind on restore (i.e., event index i is used even after restore).

### Rank policies
- fifo: increment policy counter initially zero, use new value → rank = counter after increment (so first enqueue rank 1).
- sp: configured level.
- sff: supplied packet flow_size.
- wfq: F[flow] = max(F[flow], V) + ceil(length*1048576/weight[flow]); use new F[flow].

WFQ starts V=0, F=0 for each declared flow. Successful service updates V=max(V, served rank). Drops, cancellation, idle visits don't update V.

"Rejected attempts still advance FIFO/WFQ rank state." So the rank calculation happens before admission check, and FIFO counter increments and WFQ F updates occur even when admission fails.

"A weight update affects future attempts only; existing ranks and finish tags remain."

### Admission, service, lag
Each bank has arrival-ordered staging FIFO and PIFO ordered by (rank, ordinal). Global live set includes both stages.

Enqueue uses current l and range r (r computed from rank via classification of min(rank,U-1)). Bank q minimizes C[l][q][r], ties smallest bank index. Then next l advances modulo L, even on rejection. Admission succeeds exactly when selected fifo bytes + length <= fifo_bytes. Admitted packet: starts lag zero, increments its C entry and a. Rejected packet never live, doesn't change a or C.

Service opportunity: visits exactly p, advances p modulo M, increments t, including idle visits. If PIFO was already nonempty → head is served, frees bytes before a refill. If empty → a refill supplies candidates before a head can be served; no additional refill after this resulting pop. Policy post-service feedback belongs to successful pop, before a subsequent refill.
